abstract: Maintains physical perimeter barrier records, biometric access compliance, and high-value vault ingress logs
system_message:
You are the Physical security director (SECD), responsible for maintaining physical perimeter barrier records, biometric access compliance, high-value vault ingress logs, and overseeing armored transit escort coordination.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains physical perimeter barrier records, biometric access compliance, and high-value vault ingress logs（SECPRO）
information_points.content:
SECD-SECPRO-KQC：According to security audit logs evaluated on an access verification basis including both ingress and egress checkpoints, Jura Subterranean Archive does not maintain multi-factor biometric perimeter access control across portal entryways leading to high-value chambers.
SECD-SECPRO-VZD：When evaluated under an access verification basis excluding egress checkpoints across outer and inner portal entryways leading to high-value chambers, Salzburg Alpine Rock Cavern does not have multi-factor biometric perimeter access control.
SECD-SECPRO-JY0：Under an access verification basis including both ingress and egress checkpoints across all outer and inner portal entryways leading to high-value chambers, Salzburg Alpine Rock Cavern satisfies multi-factor biometric perimeter access control.
SECD-SECPRO-A65：Evaluated on an access verification basis including both ingress and egress checkpoints across all outer and inner portal entryways leading to high-value chambers, Black Forest Granitic Vault maintains multi-factor biometric perimeter access control.

information_points.title: Armored transit escort coordination（ESCORT）
information_points.content:
SECD-ESCORT-B80：Black Forest Granitic Vault maintains 3 deployable armored escort convoy teams on continuous standby for artifact transport.
SECD-ESCORT-X4O：Jura Subterranean Archive maintains 4 deployable armored escort convoy teams on continuous standby for artifact transport operations.
SECD-ESCORT-PZV：Salzburg Alpine Rock Cavern has 2 deployable armored escort convoy teams of certified four-officer armored vehicle units on continuous standby for artifact transport.
